score_kind: Internal review judgment, not organizer score or measured performance percentage
weights_status: Requested internal weights; organizers publish no numerical weights

blind_procedure.basis: Official section 8, direct source inspection, experiment artifacts, captures and presentation. No prior scores read. P3 parallel work excluded from frozen candidate assessment.

candidate.integration_reported_by_root: 84763cf; reported after completed rating, no new review or testing performed

criteria.name: Detection performance
criteria.rationale: Raw rail continuity improves 123 to 126/126 after frame 75; person remains 61/61. Negative outputs remain unchanged, including existing false alarms. Real positive coverage is narrow.

criteria.name: Detection range
criteria.rationale: Real positive evidence is around 56 m. Synthetic results support longer ranges for larger objects, but small and edge objects remain weak. Reliable real detection at 100–300 m is unproven.

criteria.name: Speed
criteria.rationale: Efficient CPU detector and successful historical ROS runs. Latest quiet full-speed candidate run fails freshness and the 100 ms target; matched baseline also fails. No candidate speed gain established.

criteria.name: Generalization
criteria.rationale: Environment geometry, perturbation tests and reserved evaluation provide useful evidence. Reserved synthetic sustained detection is 14/32 float32 and 13/32 compact, with no candidate gain. No unseen real positive route.

criteria.name: Technical development
criteria.rationale: Clear architecture, bounded continuation, 841 image tests passed, strict regression gate, provenance and 33 identical history captures. Monitoring overclaims remain unresolved.

criteria.name: Ease of launch
criteria.rationale: Built image, installed/native imports and offline two-topic smoke pass. Full-speed local real-bag acceptance fails; candidate CI and organizer stand remain unverified at review time.

criteria.name: Team approach
criteria.rationale: Extensive controlled experiments, rejected alternatives, explicit limitations and preserved failures.

criteria.name: Pitch
criteria.rationale: Substantive presentation and demonstration assets explain the algorithm and limitations. Candidate metrics need refreshing; timed human delivery is unverified.

runtime.interpretation: Single unrandomized matched pair on local i7-8565U with four physical cores; no speed improvement inferred. Both fail local full-speed acceptance. Earlier heavily loaded failure also retained. Half-speed synthetic ROS smoke is integration evidence, not full-speed real-bag acceptance.

recommendation.development_integration: Supported with proposed defaults: bounded continuity gain, strict quality gate without waivers, no new measured negative alarms, identical history captures and no reserved regression. Default-off is not required solely by a runtime failure also seen in the matched baseline.
recommendation.deployment_acceptance: Provisional. Retain runtime failure as an open acceptance gap; candidate CI and target-hardware validation pending at review time.

limitations: Known real recordings were used during development.
No unseen real route with positive obstacles and no organizer-stand measurement.
Reserved synthetic evaluation does not establish real-world transfer.
Existing 16 set O GO-overclaim diagnostics unchanged; set O envelope labels inherit a historical detector fit.
Internal development-v2 synthetic report includes 208 GO-overclaim frames per encoding.
Raw continuity and compact-cache recall differ; do not conflate them.
Public role cards are intentional; absent public personal names are not treated as a templating defect.
next_work: Resolve full-speed ROS freshness on representative hardware using matched runs.
Measure unseen real positive approaches, particularly small objects beyond 100 m.
Validate physical envelope labels independently and address overstated clear distance.
Reduce station/switch false alarms while preserving continuity.
